I'm not sure about the general idea here @lebaphi .

If we filter the channels so that only collab-channels are seen, we can't see the other channel types (such as chat or mapping).

That's not an option.  But, what are you proposing here?

> I'm not sure about the general idea here @lebaphi .
> 
> If we filter the channels so that only collab-channels are seen, we can't see the other channel types (such as chat or mapping).
> 
> That's not an option. But, what are you proposing here?

Hi @IanMayo, the idea is do the filter to show all the valid channels in the admin controls page. In the past I see we show a un support message when clicking on the legacy channel data, so we can do a filter here then the legacy channel won’t show up in the admin controls page. We should update the filter condition, I think it’s not enough 😉

> We should update the filter condition, I think it’s not enough 😉

Ahh, ok. I see.  The _actual_ answer is to delete the legacy channel. I should have done that :-)

But, I _think_ we will still have a problem where switching between `chat` and `collab` channels can still show the wrong columns.

> Ahh, ok. I see. The actual answer is to delete the legacy channel. I should have done that :-)

If we can delete the legacy data, it would be ok. I though to make it work with the legacy data in the old user machine :D

I will check it out @IanMayo
